text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I had it today, but... well, you
saw the
results.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What am I supposed to do? I feel like
I'm
stumbling down a dark street
completely blind...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't start tripping up now, but I
also
don't feel like there's enough time
to do anything
about it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't start tripping up now, but I
also
don't feel like there's enough time
to do anything
about it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Even if I can't see where I'm
going,
I'll get there eventually if I keep
walking. One
step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's start by figuring out why I lost
today. I think
that might shine some light
on the path ahead.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Let's try to win next
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You're always such a force of

encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can't just sit around moping and
sighing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Next time, I'm gonna get out
there and win!
